name: scene-chai
title: Chai
description: Three small ink drawings on one sheet, meant as a loader, a toggle and a divider: a cutting-chai glass whose steam follows a curl-noise field, a clay diya whose flame leans from the pointer and goes out with a curl of smoke, and a tulsi creeper that grows along a rule. Set lit to put the lamp out or light it. Quiet is the plate's still; warm steams and flickers; playful takes a tap on the flame and a hover on the creeper.
